headline: Commis Cook
summary: TESDA-certified cook with a year in the kitchen of a seafood restaurant in Tuguegarao. I prepare ingredients and cook fish and shellfish dishes on the line, follow food safety and hygiene rules strictly, and check every plate for quality before it leaves the pass. I want to grow into a chef de partie role.

projects.name: River fish specials
bullets: Developed three weekend specials using freshwater fish from the Cagayan River with the sous chef.

projects.name: Cookery NC II assessment dishes
projects.description: Prepared a full set of hot and cold dishes for the national assessment and passed on the first attempt.

skills: HACCP basics and food safety principles
Checking plates for quality and consistency

experience.title: Commis Cook
bullets: Prepare vegetables, sauces and seafood for 150 to 200 covers a night.
Cook grilled, steamed and fried seafood dishes on the hot line.
Label, date and store ingredients following first-in, first-out rules.
Clean and sanitise my station and log fridge temperatures every shift.

experience.title: Kitchen Trainee
bullets: Rotated through cold kitchen, bakery and hot line under supervising cooks.
